comment: Every check the Arch/KVM acceptance must report. 'exercises' says whether a check tests production providerd/unit/operator behaviour or only the harness itself. Evidence must contain exactly one record per id.

checks.description: QEMU runs with -accel kvm; no TCG fallback
Guest NIC is QEMU user networking with restrict=on: no route to the host or the internet; egress attempts fail
Guest image matches the pinned version, SHA-256 and signature in arch-image.json
Guest carries this run's disposable-guest marker; the guest runner refuses anywhere else
uid/gid real, effective, saved, fs are the provider account; no supplementary group
All capability sets are empty
NoNewPrivs=1 and Seccomp=2 (filter)
User, mount, net, ipc, uts, pid, cgroup namespace creation refused
Flowerly state (/var/lib/flowerly, state.db, /run/flowerly, evolution state) unreadable
Unrelated credentials, root, other homes, shadow, operator ledger and evidence unreadable
CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY exposes exactly <instance>.key; the encrypted source is unreadable; contents never read
No writes outside the unit's runtime directory
setuid(0), /proc/1, /proc/sys writes, /dev/kvm, /dev/mem refused
Loopback IPv4/IPv6 connects blocked by the OS (EPERM) with a live listener present
Link-local IPv4/IPv6 and metadata connects blocked by the OS (EPERM) with a live listener present
AF_PACKET, AF_NETLINK, raw ICMP and other forbidden families refused
The loopback DNS stub allowed by the operator drop-in stays reachable
RFC 1918, CGNAT and ULA are NOT blocked by the OS (recorded, application policy only)
--require-isolated-identity: extra supplementary group makes the real unit fail and install refuse
Positive discovery over verified TLS to the public-classified mock address, default production policy
accept sends exactly one chat request; evidence holds no prompt, text, bearer or key
Name resolving to RFC 1918 refused (address_refused, not_sent); sink sees no connection
Name resolving to CGNAT refused; sink sees no connection
Name resolving to loopback refused; sink sees no connection
Name resolving to link-local refused; sink sees no connection
Name resolving to the metadata address refused; sink sees no connection
Name resolving to IPv6 ULA refused; sink sees no connection
DNS rebinding public then private at connection time refused; private sink sees no connection
Certificate from an untrusted CA fails as tls, not_sent; no plaintext fallback
Certificate for the wrong name fails as tls, not_sent
302 to another host fails as redirect_refused; target sees no connection
HTTP 401 fails as auth_failed; later submits refused without sending
HTTP 429 fails as rate_limited with bounded retry_after_ms
HTTP 503 fails as server_error with outcome unknown; never retried automatically
Discovery without the allowlisted model: model not served, no prompt sent
Response naming another model fails as model_mismatch
Response over 1 MiB fails as oversized
Malformed JSON fails as invalid_response
tool_calls in the response fail as unsupported_response
Missing usage is reported as unknown (null), never 0
Connection dropped mid-body after 200 reports outcome unknown
Delayed response below the timeout succeeds with measured latency
Duplicate request_id with identical arguments yields one chat request; different arguments refused
Discovery-only preflight refuses provider.submit with discover_only
Journal and evidence scan finds no sentinel prompt, dummy key, bearer header or model text
flowerlyd with AGENTIC_USERS_GROUP=flowerly-provider-clients reports remote inference disabled
flowerly with the clients group effective: admitted
flowerly started before joining the group (stale credentials): refused
Ordinary user without the group: refused at connect
Unrelated user with effective membership via setpriv --groups: admitted (membership is the boundary)
root without the group: refused at the peer check
root with the group: admitted (root trusted by the threat model)
flowerly-provider service account: admitted
Two admitted processes under distinct uids get distinct created_by
Cross-uid poll, cancel and result retrieval refused
After flowerlyd restart, its effective Groups include the clients group only then
install starts and enables nothing
Missing credential: the unit fails to start, nothing is sent
Invalid instance configuration: refused, nothing is sent
Two instances: rolling back one keeps the other and all shared resources
Shared resources in use (process, binary user, group member): nothing shared changes
Partial rollback keeps the ledger entries it could not remove; rerun completes
install killed after systemd-sysusers: recovery removes only what install created
rollback killed midway: the documented rerun completes
Foreign file with identical contents is never removed
Symlink substitution of a recorded path or parent is refused
Modified instance file is kept, ledger keeps it, preflight refuses
Corrupt ledger refuses rollback with no change
Concurrent operator commands: the second refuses on the lock
disable masks and stops the unit and moves the gate aside
rollback-shared removes shared resources only after the final consumer exits
After final rollback the guest matches the pre-install snapshot
